summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Industrials ETF (RSPN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of industrial US stocks drawn from the S&P 500. RSPN was launched on Nov 1, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: RSPN is an equity ETF with a total of 86 individual holdings. The top holdings are Generac Holdings stock at 1.39%, Southwest Airlines Co. at 1.33%, Bloom Energy at 1.33%, Delta Air Lines at 1.32%, and AMETEK at 1.30%.
